summary: Empty state with one of four pixel illustrations that drop into place and float, plus a title, a line of help and room for actions.

props.name: kind
props.description: Illustration and default copy. Changing it drops the new illustration in.

props.name: heading
props.description: Title. Defaults to "No messages yet", "No results", "Something went wrong" or "All caught up".

props.name: description
props.description: Help line under the title. Defaults to a sentence for the kind.

props.name: children
props.description: Actions, such as buttons, centred under the text.

accessibility: The title is an `<h3>`; the heading level cannot be changed.
motion: With reduced motion the pixels appear in place without dropping, and the floating and sparkles are off.
notes: `error` draws in the warning colour and `done` in the success colour; the other kinds use the accent.
Without reduced motion the illustration animates continuously while it is on screen.
